system.summary: Two-digit figure cipher, groups mostly ending in 5 or 0, with a few letter signs (f, k, u, y), set inside clear Italian.
system.notes: Homophones on the anneal's evidence (e = 0, 25; a = 86, 80 ...). Group boundaries inferred (no spaces); a second reading of P2 L04-L07 disagrees on 13 of 92 groups. Not the Caprile 1520-21 sign cipher (caprile1520) nor the 1519 two-tier cipher (caprile1519).

prior_solution.where: none found in ASMo, Vestigia, DECODE or print

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code with Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: DECODE R1126-R1140 metadata and images; Vestigia search Cistarelli (20 records); R1137 = Cistarelli no. 3 (Vestigia 1904).
A subagent transcribed R1137 P2: 584 two-digit groups and 83 other signs (667 tokens), group boundaries inferred.
Ciphertext-only anneal on Cistarelli's R1137 with consensus fixing; phrases only (lettere per, presto, non se poteria, dua milla).
Known keys for R1137: key21, the 1519 tables, Bonzagni 1512-14, Sadoleto 1482 and Maffeo 1489 are sign alphabets; DECODE harvest lists no Este/ASMo key 1490-1550; no numeric key to apply.

R1137 ciphertext-only anneal (fastanneal, order 4, 6 x 60k) against the same tokens shuffled: -2.69 vs -3.05 per token, so there is language signal, but the output gives only fragments ('auan[ti]', 'edirit[o]'); not read.
R1137 P1, P3, P4 viewed at overview scale (the transcription had not checked them): P1 and P3 clear text, P4 address; cipher only on P2.

R1137 P2 spot-check of L04-L07 against the image (autocontrast bands, native resolution): 13 of 92 groups read differently from r1137_transcription.txt (85/95, 45/95, 0/5/6, 80/86, group boundaries); the full 584-group re-check was not completed because the image does not settle these digits.

R1137 crib test (r1137_crib.py, ORDER 5, 20 restarts base, 4 windows x 3 restarts x 80k per word, word-level segmentation rerank): cribs custode, agria, alfonso, debito, buda, episcopato give anneal gains -57 to -348 (mean -169), six control words -49 to -363 (mean -172); best word score is a control. No crib lands.

Entry split on 14 Oct 2026 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026) from caprile1519, which had joined three ciphers of the same ASMo file: the 1519 two-tier cipher (caprile1519), the 1520-21 sign cipher (caprile1520) and Cistarelli's figure cipher (cistarelli1520). This profile keeps the documents and steps of Cistarelli's figure cipher (R1137) only.

Catalogue 846 (Brice Dudout, 28 Oct 2026): Vestigia V1908 image already in caprile1519/img/v/v1908_1.jpg (photo of a photocopy). Clear text shows the addressee is Duke Alfonso I (Vestigia), written from Kraków, reporting the illness and death of 'mio Ill.mo S.re et patrone' (Cardinal Ippolito, d. 3 Sept 1520). Same signs as R1137 (two-digit groups ending 0/5, letters f k u y x h g m), so the same key: joined to this entry.
V1908 line 7 transcribed (34 tokens) and the end of line 27 (7 tokens); lines 28-34 about six cipher lines too faded in the photocopy to transcribe.

R1137 anneal key applied to V1908 line 7: 'adlmodegmo?racentogseti?tipodtare'; joint anneal R1137+V1908 (12 x 120k, fixed consensus values): 'adlmodelmoframentossediftiportare', 'dancoar'. Fragments ('portare'), no reading.

outcome.method_basis: Ciphertext-only annealing over both letters gives a partly consistent key and scattered phrases but no reading; no key or decipherment exists, R1137's image does not settle the digits and most of V1908's cipher is lost in the photocopy.
outcome.fraction_read_source: No group of R1137 is claimed as read; the anneal fragments (lettere per, presto, saria meglio) are grade M at best and are not a reading (f37_*.txt, r1137_crib_out.txt).
outcome.notes: Attempted, open. Language signal above a shuffled control (-2.69 vs -3.05 per token), but fragments only. Blockers: transcription noise (14 % disagreement on a spot-check) on the only image, no key in the series, archive or decade. Split 14 Oct 2026 from caprile1519. 28 Oct 2026: V1908 (catalogue 846) joined, same cipher; not read.

gaps.detail: the DECODE image does not settle the digits (13/92 groups disagree between two readings); no key exists; cribs = controls; a better photograph from ASMo (b. 4/26 no. 3) is the next step (judgement, not proven)

gaps.item: V1908 (14 Oct 1520), line 7 and about six cipher lines at the foot
gaps.detail: only a photograph of an old photocopy exists online; lines 28-34 are lost in its dark bands; Brice Dudout has asked ASMo for the original (28 Oct 2026); the R1137 anneal key does not read the legible line
